name: Haunt's visage has real health instead of being a one-hit-kill decoy (#9260)
contract: Haunt 573425 (only castable while stealthed, per its own ONLY_STEALTHED requirement) summons the 'Uncanny Likeness' visage (840000, a level-1 0.5-HealthModifier template, ~21 max health regardless of the summoning player's level) for CLASS_REAPER in AscensionWitchDoctorSummons.cpp. Before this fix no SetMaxHealth/SetHealth override was applied in this branch (unlike the other Witch Doctor pet branches a few lines below, which do scale HP off the player's level), so the decoy could be one-shot before it ever drew a hit away from the player, matching the report's 'kept getting dropped almost immediately'. The fix scales the visage's max health to player level * 10 like those sibling branches. 1% of the old ~21 max health rounds to 0 (the harness's own CountPctFromMaxHealth, which the set_health_pct action uses, refuses to deal zero damage), while 1% of a level-80 player's 800 scaled max health is a clean 8 - an independent, harness-native way to distinguish the two without needing a mob to land the first hit.

steps.label: Haunt is only castable while stealthed
DISCRIMINATING: 1% of the scaled max health is 8, not 0 like the old ~21 hp template
The visage is still alive after being reduced to 1% of its real max health
